youtube_live_setup: In YouTube Studio go to Create → Go live → choose Stream (or use OBS with your stream key).
Start the broadcast so the stream status is LIVE (not just scheduled).
Open the live watch page in a browser; the URL is youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID — copy the value after v=.
On the server edit /var/www/html/data/fleet_stream_live.json and set youtube_video_id to that ID (letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore only).
Redeploy or save the file; hard-refresh /fleet-progress-monitor/ and the frontpage chat rail — the YouTube player loads the embed for that video ID.
For premieres, use the scheduled video ID before go-live; swap to the live broadcast ID when YouTube switches to live.
Never put RTMP stream keys in this JSON — only the public video ID.
